name: Greatech Technology Berhad
summary: Greatech Technology Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the design and construction of customized factory automation solutions and system integration. The company is involved in the design and manufacture of single automated equipment; production of line system; provision of related components and engineering services; and design, development, and precision engineering of custom automated equipment. It also offers value-added services, including supply, training, and comprehensive after-sales support.
